title: GeoDirectory (WordPress) < 2.8.194 — listing disclosure, path traversal, and guest-listing broken access control

affected_technologies.note: All three issues are fixed in GeoDirectory 2.8.194.

steps: Update the GeoDirectory plugin to >= 2.8.194 on every site.
Review draft/pending/private listings that may have been read via the markers REST route while running an affected version.
Audit guest-submitted (post_author = 0) listings for unauthorized edits, re-categorisation, or trashing.
Check the uploads directory and server logs for unexpected republished files and for files deleted via listing saves.
mitigations_if_upgrade_impossible: Disable guest posting (GeoDirectory 'Allow posting without logging in?' / post_logged_out) to remove the CVE-2026-113674 attack surface.
Block unauthenticated access to /wp-json/geodir/v2/markers/<id> at the edge (it is only needed for map popups of public listings).
Restrict who can submit/edit listings and monitor admin-ajax.php geodir_save_post / geodir_auto_save_post.

vulnerabilities.title: Unauthenticated non-public listing disclosure via marker-popup REST route
preconditions: One or more non-public gd_place listings exist (ids are sequential/enumerable).

request_signatures: Unauthenticated GET to /wp-json/geodir/v2/markers/<numeric id>, especially sequential id enumeration.
behavioral: 200 responses from the markers route for listing ids that return 404 on the front end.

signatures: request path matches ^/wp-json/geodir/v[0-9]+/markers/[0-9]+$ from an unauthenticated client
waf.false_positive_notes: Legitimate map popups also use this route; prefer upgrading. If blocking, allow it only for known-public listing ids or from the site's own map pages.

vulnerabilities.title: Authenticated (Subscriber+) path traversal via listing-save image URL (arbitrary file read/republish and delete)
preconditions: Default Add Listing page and gd_place type.

request_signatures: admin-ajax.php action=geodir_save_post with a post_images entry whose URL contains '/geodir_temp/' followed by '../'.
Image URLs pointing at /geodir_temp/ with path-traversal sequences and an image extension.
behavioral: Files appearing in uploads whose source is outside the uploads tree.
Unexpected deletion of image-named files on the server during listing saves.

signatures: action=geodir_save_post|geodir_auto_save_post AND a post_images value matching geodir_temp/.*\.\.
waf.false_positive_notes: Legitimate saves reference geodir_temp files by plain filename with no '..'; the '..' sequence is the reliable signal.

vulnerabilities.title: Unauthenticated broken access control over guest-submitted listings
preconditions: GeoDirectory 'Allow posting without logging in?' (post_logged_out) enabled.

request_signatures: Unauthenticated admin-ajax.php action=geodir_save_post / geodir_auto_save_post referencing an existing listing ID (post_status=trash, changed post_title/post_category).
behavioral: Guest listings changing title/category/status with no corresponding owner session.
Listings with post_author=0 being trashed or edited by logged-out requests.

signatures: Unauthenticated (no logged-in cookie) POST with action=geodir_save_post or geodir_auto_save_post that includes an existing ID
waf.false_positive_notes: Only relevant when guest posting is enabled; disabling post_logged_out is the most reliable mitigation.
